method.sample_selection: frame_observations.records filtered by phase == 'sample'; warmup excluded
method.p95: Sorted values at zero-based min(n-1, floor(n*0.95)), matching probe convention; no interpolation.
method.after_paint_and_tick_intervals: Raw probe summary; tick timestamps are smoothed frame times and may cross the warmup boundary.
method.cpu_scope: this process and its threads only; excludes compositor, Xorg, GPU and kernel workers
method.paint_scope: callback phase wall time includes update/layout/drawing and any waits; not GPU execution time
method.gap_scope: time outside observed paint callbacks; does not by itself identify a compositor, scheduler or GPU wait
method.feedback_read: after sampling stops, without draining pending events; final frames may remain incomplete
method.repetitions: One accepted baseline/candidate pair; no distribution across repeated runs.

matched_conditions.workload: 24 rounded libadwaita cards with labels, buttons and switches; 240px/s scroll
matched_conditions.kernel_context: Both v25, as reported by the board-controlling agent; raw GTK documents do not embed uname.
matched_conditions.display_context: 1080p60 as reported for both trials; candidate session log explicitly records 1920x1080 at 60Hz.
matched_conditions.session_checks: Both unlocked and overview inactive at start, end of warmup and end; not continuous observation.

excluded_sample.reason: Actual Cairo renderer and differing GDK_DISABLE/LIBGL_DRIVERS_PATH invalidate this as the OpenGL A/B candidate.
excluded_sample.alias_note: Do not attribute exclusion to the requested gl spelling alone; GTK4.18.6 gl/opengl/ngl are renderer aliases.

board_findings.gi_startup: Candidate-prefix executable and all four Mutter/Cogl/Clutter/Mtk libraries; GNOME Shell JS started successfully.
board_findings.feedback: 542 of 544 candidate sample records have refresh_interval_us=16667; remaining two are incomplete with zero interval. All presentation timestamps remain zero.
board_findings.trace_limits: Logging is bounded to eight messages per surface. Its cumulative maximum is not a latency distribution and cannot be assigned to the accepted sample window.
board_findings.pvr_snapshot: Driver/Firmware OK; all reported error counters zero. This is not full service acceptance.
board_findings.service_warnings: Accessibility/calendar/Polkit/GeoClue warnings remain in the session log.
board_findings.rollback: Controlling agent performed rollback. Cited rollback log records baseline session config restoration, daemon.conf hash verification and healthy PVR snapshot; it does not include postrollback library maps.

conclusion: GI launcher fixes the demonstrated duplicate-Clutter startup failure, and SBC completion/refresh feedback is observed on hardware.
Callback throughput increased about 6.9%, but test-process CPU increased about 14.8% and CPU per callback increased. This does not establish an overall efficiency improvement.
After-paint long intervals decreased, while its median increased and tick long intervals plus paint-span tail latency worsened. Performance evidence is mixed.
No scanout timestamps are available. Callback throughput must not be called display FPS, stable 60Hz presentation, or completed desktop acceptance.
Candidate remains experimental and was rolled back; no promotion into the production image.
next_direction: Measure EGL query/notification cost and completion-latency distribution before altering the 2ms polling algorithm.
If pursued further, repeat matched baseline/candidate runs with CPU and latency observations; one pair cannot isolate causality or run-to-run variation.
Keep the v26 storage DMA experiment separate; it does not belong in this compositor A/B.
